get.summary: Public keys that verify access tokens
get.description: The current ES256 signing key and any retired keys still inside their rotation window. Public, cacheable.

get.summary: The current terms and privacy policy versions
get.description: Public and cacheable. The register page sends these versions back as its consent.

post.summary: Create a student or parent account and sign in
post.description: Records consent to the current terms and privacy versions (getLegalVersions) and emails a verification link. Returns the access and refresh tokens in the body for the web BFF to hold server side; the API sets no cookies. 409 identity.email_taken, 409 identity.consent_outdated, 429 identity.too_many_attempts with Retry-After.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Starts a session and returns the access and refresh tokens in the body for the web BFF to hold server side; the API sets no cookies. 401 identity.invalid_credentials for any wrong email or password. Repeated failures answer 429 identity.too_many_attempts with Retry-After, the same response the rate limiters give, so it never shows whether an account exists or is locked.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens
post.description: The refresh token is the credential. Returns a new access token and a new refresh token in the body for the web BFF to hold server side (no cookies); the presented token is used up. Presenting a used token again is treated as theft and ends the whole session, so the BFF must serialise refreshes per session. 401 identity.refresh_token_invalid for any token that cannot be used.

post.summary: Sign out of the current session
post.description: Ends the session named by the access token: its refresh token stops working and the access token is refused immediately. The web BFF then discards the tokens it holds. Idempotent; no body.

post.summary: Confirm an email address with the emailed link's token
post.description: Each link works once. 400 identity.token_invalid for an unknown, used or expired link.

post.summary: Send a new email verification link
post.description: Always 202, whether or not the address has an unverified account, so it cannot be used to find accounts. A new link replaces older ones; repeats within 60 seconds send nothing new.

post.summary: Email a password reset link
post.description: Always 202 with no body, whether or not the address has an account, so it cannot be used to find accounts. The link is valid for 60 minutes and replaces older ones.

post.summary: Set a new password with the emailed reset link's token
post.description: Signs the account out everywhere: every session and refresh token ends. The link works once. 400 identity.token_invalid for an unknown, used or expired link; 400 identity.password_rejected with field errors.

post.summary: Sign in to an existing account with a Google ID token
post.description: Google never creates an account: 404 identity.account_not_found when no account uses the Google address. An account with the same verified address is linked on first use. Returns the tokens in the body for the web BFF to hold server side; no cookies. 401 identity.google_token_invalid, 409 identity.google_email_unverified, 503 identity.google_unavailable.

get.summary: Your account: profile, roles, permissions and onboarding state
get.description: Permissions come from the server's role map; the web app gates navigation on them. Never cached.

get.summary: Your signed-in devices
get.description: Active sessions only, newest activity first, at most 50. current marks the one making this request.

delete.summary: Sign one of your devices out
delete.description: Its refresh token stops working and its access token is refused immediately. Revoking the current session is a logout. Idempotent. 404 identity.session_not_found for an unknown id or another user's session.

post.summary: Sign out every other device
post.description: Keeps the session making the request. Idempotent; returns how many sessions were signed out.

put.description: Saves a draft step; switching level clears the other stage's details. Optional If-Match with the ETag from a previous onboarding response; a stale value returns 409 concurrency_conflict. 403 identity.onboarding_students_only.

put.summary: Save grade or study level, exam body, institution and date of birth (students)
put.description: A draft step: any subset of fields, each checked against the stored level (400 identity.level_not_set, 400 identity.stage_mismatch). missing lists what completion still needs. The date of birth is set once (409 identity.date_of_birth_already_set). Optional If-Match; a stale value returns 409 concurrency_conflict.

post.summary: Finish onboarding (students and parents)
post.description: Merges the body over the saved draft; a client may also skip the draft steps and send everything here. 409 identity.onboarding_incomplete lists the missing fields in errors. Idempotent: a repeat returns the same completedAt. 403 identity.onboarding_not_applicable for admins.

patch.summary: Change your name or phone number, or set your date of birth or adult confirmation once
patch.description: Fields left out are unchanged; phoneNumber: null clears it. dateOfBirth (students) and adultConfirmed (parents) can each be set once: 409 identity.date_of_birth_already_set. Email changes are a separate flow. Optional If-Match; a stale value returns 409 concurrency_conflict.

post.summary: Change your password
post.description: Needs the current password (not for Google-only accounts setting a first one). Signs out every other device; this session keeps working. 401 identity.invalid_credentials for a wrong current password, which counts toward the sign-in lockout (429 identity.too_many_attempts with Retry-After).

post.summary: Ask for your account and personal information to be deleted
post.description: Erasure starts after a 14 day cooling-off period, during which you can still sign in and cancel. 202 for a new request, 200 with the existing one if a request is already pending. Password accounts must give the current password: 401 identity.invalid_credentials, counted toward the sign-in lockout.

delete.description: Idempotent: 204 also when nothing is pending. 409 identity.erasure_in_progress once erasure has started.

get.summary: The legal documents and optional consents you accepted
get.description: Newest first, with the version, when and how each was given.

post.summary: Accept the current terms and privacy versions
post.description: Idempotent per version. marketingEmails true opts in, false withdraws. 409 identity.consent_outdated when the versions are not the current ones from getLegalVersions.

get.summary: List published FAQs
get.description: Published FAQs ordered by category, then sort order. Public, no authentication.

post.summary: Create an FAQ
Start a tutor conversation

get.summary: List your tutor conversations
get.description: Your own conversations, most recently active first.

get.summary: Get one of your tutor conversations with its messages

delete.summary: Delete one of your tutor conversations

post.summary: Send a message to the tutor and stream the answer
post.description: Streams Server-Sent Events: route, token, tool_call, citation and confirm while the tutor works, then exactly one done (the answer is saved) or error (whatever arrived is saved as incomplete or failed).

get.summary: CAPS subjects for a curriculum and grade
get.description: Active subjects, compulsory first, then by category and name. Public: onboarding needs it before sign-in completes.

get.summary: Search tertiary institutions
get.description: Active catalog institutions, best match first. Public: onboarding needs it.

get.summary: Search shared courses at your institution
get.description: Courses other students at your catalog institution already created, for the course picker.

post.summary: Add CAPS subjects
post.description: High school students only. Returns 201 when anything new was added, 200 when every subject was already yours.

post.summary: Add a university course
post.description: University students only. Joins the shared course when another student at your institution already created it.

get.summary: List your subjects or courses
get.description: Your enrolments with the next due assessment and the weighting summary of each.

get.summary: Get one of your subjects or courses
get.description: The id is the enrolment id from listMyUnits. The ETag header is the version for If-Match on updateMyUnit.

patch.summary: Change your settings for one of your units
patch.description: Optional If-Match with the ETag from a previous response; a stale value returns 409.

delete.summary: Remove one of your subjects or courses
delete.description: Deletes the enrolment and its assessments. Pass confirm=true when it has marks (409 academics.unit_has_marks otherwise).

get.summary: List the topics of one of your units
get.description: Canonical topics (merged duplicates resolved), sorted by name. The id is the enrolment id.

post.summary: Add an assessment to one of your units

get.summary: List your assessments
get.description: Your assessments across units, filtered and paged, by due date.

get.summary: Get one of your assessments
get.description: Includes the actions allowed from its state. The ETag header is the version for If-Match on updateMyAssessment.

patch.description: Optional If-Match with the ETag from a previous response; a stale value returns 409.

post.summary: Move one of your assessments through its lifecycle
Record the mark of one of your assessments
post.description: Grades the assessment and returns it with the unit's refreshed weighting.

post.summary: Generate a practice test for one of your assessments
post.description: Answers 202 at once and generates in the background; poll statusUrl. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 64 letters, digits, dashes or underscores): a replay returns the same test and job. One generation at a time per student (409 practice.generation_in_progress with jobId) and a daily limit (429).

get.summary: Poll the generation status of one of your practice tests
Your practice test generation in progress, if any
get.description: Lets another device recover a generation started elsewhere. 204 when nothing is generating.

get.summary: List your practice tests
get.description: Newest first, filtered and paged, with each test's attempt.

get.summary: Get the instructions of one of your practice tests
get.description: Never includes answers. While the test's attempt is active it includes the attempt state for resuming.

delete.summary: Remove one of your practice tests
delete.description: A test you attempted is archived and stays in your history; one you never attempted is deleted. 409 practice.attempt_active while its attempt is in progress.

post.summary: Start your one attempt at a practice test
post.description: Call after the student has read the instructions; questions are only ever sent from here on. Any body is ignored: times come from the server clock. Each test can be attempted once (409 practice.attempt_exists with attemptId) and only one attempt can be active at a time (409 practice.other_attempt_active).

get.summary: Your practice test in progress, if any
get.description: For the "test in progress" banner. 204 when there is none.

get.summary: Get one of your attempts to resume it
get.description: While active: questions, saved answers, remainingSeconds and serverNow. Once submitted: status and resultsUrl only.

put.summary: Autosave your answer to one question
put.description: Send baseRevision = the revision you last saw. A stale revision returns 409 practice.revision_conflict with currentRevision. Refused while paused, after submission, and after a timed attempt's deadline plus 10 seconds.

post.summary: Report that the test lost focus
post.description: Losses within 2 seconds of the previous one count once. Informational only: it never fails an attempt.

post.summary: Pause an untimed attempt
post.description: Timed tests cannot pause (409 practice.pause_not_allowed). Pausing a paused attempt returns its state.

post.summary: Resume a paused attempt
post.description: Resuming an attempt that is not paused returns its state.

post.summary: Submit your attempt for marking
post.description: Multiple choice is marked at once; written answers are marked in the background (status grading). Submitting again returns the current status. After a timed attempt's deadline plus 10 seconds the auto-submit owns it (409 practice.deadline_passed).

get.summary: Get the marked paper of one of your attempts
get.description: 409 practice.results_not_ready while the attempt is in progress or paused.
